events.title: Stop the Thread Editing Abuse!
events.description: After Omniscient previously removed the Junk feature due to abuse, members have been working around it by editing old threads — changing the title to 'closed' or 'junk' and replacing the body with requests to junk. Omniscient and the staff team are cracking down and banning members for this behavior; some accounts have even been closed.

events.title: No More Discussions in Weekly Reports
events.description: iHydra has changed the rule for the Weekly Reports thread — discussion posts are no longer allowed and will be junked. Members are asked to discuss reported items in the weekly edition threads instead. The team also introduced an experimental 'Breaking News' thread concept for time-sensitive HF events.
